messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 17):
"""
3.7 Specify Non-forfeiture conditions [When the contract would be not null and void] 3.8 Specify options available under the product. (e.g. to increase or decrease benefits, plan changes, etc.) [This section should specify the various options available under the product. The charges, if any, towards the cost of the option shall also be specified. ] 3.9 Furnish complete information on already approved add-ons, proposed to be attached with this product if any 3.9.1 Add-ons attached to the product S.N o Add-on Name UIN allotted by IRDAI Date of clearance 3.9.2 Any other features that may be relevant for the product.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What information must a health insurance product provide about options to modify benefits?","answer":"The product must specify the various options available, such as increasing or decreasing benefits or plan changes, and state any charges associated with those options.","facts":["Specify options available under the product","to increase or decrease benefits, plan changes, etc.","charges, if any, towards the cost of the option shall also be specified"]},{"question":"How should a health insurance product list approved add‑ons?","answer":"It must furnish complete information on already approved add‑ons, including a table with serial number, add‑on name, UIN allotted by IRDAI, and date of clearance.","facts":["Furnish complete information on already approved add-ons","Add-ons attached to the product S.N o Add-on Name UIN allotted by IRDAI Date of clearance"]}]}
